answer: Price sybils, not police them: admit identities by sealed-bid second-price auction. Each epoch mints slots equal to 1% of identities; winners pay the second-highest bid into an escrow vault, unlocked only on resale. Peers refuse activation if vault funding is absent on-ledger. The nebula of entrants is the auction's demand side: an operator fielding M clones bids against itself, inflating the price paid M times; honest agents bid truthfully, recovering capital by resale. Sybil capital finds no haven: locked, illiquid, repriced by each clone; farming margins break.
